pk-0iLc.title: Vegetation: hilly pine forest, cable car
pk-0iLc.summary: Northeast of Islamabad, hilly forests of tall pine trees. Some coverage was taken from an aerial cable lift.

pk-6RPD.title: Houses: gothic university building
pk-6RPD.summary: A university in the big Punjab city has gothic-style architecture.

pk-9S3l.title: Coverage: only a few tourist spots
pk-9S3l.summary: Coverage is extremely limited, found only in Punjab near big temples and tourist sights. Only the spots you can pinpoint are covered here.

pk-9r6V.title: Coverage: poor semi-urban area, thick haze
pk-9r6V.summary: In an eastern suburb, coverage is semi-urban, in a fairly poor-looking neighbourhood, under very thick haze.

pk-D9uS.title: Hidden coverage: narrow alleyway
pk-D9uS.summary: A narrow alleyway, just north of the market street.

pk-JW5b.title: Landmark: minigolf and cow statue
pk-JW5b.summary: In the southwestern suburbs, a hotel has a minigolf course in front and a cow statue by its entrance.

pk-K3qO.title: Landscape: hazy sky and hills
pk-K3qO.summary: North of Sargodha, coverage has a hazy sky and hilly ground.

pk-Kxq2.title: Coverage: walled gardens and old forts
pk-Kxq2.summary: A lot of coverage is in big, orderly gardens, often inside stone walls with old temples or forts. These are called Mughal gardens.

pk-Q2S5.title: Hidden coverage: trekker in busy alleys
pk-Q2S5.summary: Just south of the big fort, a trekker walks narrow, very busy city streets. This is hidden coverage too.

pk-Rtub.title: Landmark: large fortress with iconic gate
pk-Rtub.summary: A large fortress whose Alamgiri Gate is one of the most famous monuments in the country.

pk-TP63.title: Houses: red brick campus, red brick paths
pk-TP63.summary: A women's college is mostly traditional red brick buildings, often with red brick paths.

pk-Ujiq.title: Google car: baggy bright trekker pants
pk-Ujiq.summary: The trekker wears bright, baggy pants. This mostly helps tell it from Gen 3 trekkers in India, where the pants are tighter.

pk-VlpT.title: Hidden coverage: very busy urban street
pk-VlpT.summary: Just west of the rug-roofed market street is a very busy-looking urban street.

pk-XzFd.title: Hidden coverage: grey car at a fort
pk-XzFd.summary: A grey car with its right side visible drives around a fort in the north of a big city. It is hidden coverage, only reachable through the Map Making App and some community maps.

pk-aJMI.title: Coverage: forest path with a narrow channel
pk-aJMI.summary: In a forest park, the path points northeast with a narrow water channel running beside it, on the north or south side.

pk-ciEV.title: Coverage: trekker on a narrow concrete path
pk-ciEV.summary: West of Sahiwal and northwest of Harappa, a trekker starts at a museum, and most of the route is a very narrow concrete path.

pk-evsi.title: Language: Urdu and English on signs
pk-evsi.summary: Urdu is the national language and the most common on signs. Its script looks almost like Arabic but is usually softer and curvier. English is also common.

pk-mIzg.title: Landmark: green-domed mosque, green minarets
pk-mIzg.summary: In western Kasur, a mosque with a big green dome and two smaller green domes on its minarets. The minarets are visible from most spots.

pk-qZn2.title: Landmark: almost black fortress walls
pk-qZn2.summary: West of Jhelum, a fort has almost black walls. They are often visible in the distance rather than nearby.

pk-rucD.title: Houses: white colonial building, domes
pk-rucD.summary: A big white colonial building with large white domes circled by black lines, part of a medical university.

pk-wAJF.title: Landscape: road between red brick walls
pk-wAJF.summary: Inside the fort, a road runs between tall red brick walls on both sides.

pk-y4Tl.title: Landmark: small temple in a lake
pk-y4Tl.summary: A small temple surrounded by a lake with one bridge to land, just northwest of Sheikhupura.

pk-yktB.title: Plate: short, green strip on left
pk-yktB.summary: Plates are short and each region has its own design. All coverage is in Punjab, so most plates have a green strip on the left, and fully green ones are also common.

pk-zWRb.title: Coverage: Gen 3 trekker
pk-zWRb.summary: Most coverage was shot with an older Gen 3 trekker camera, carried on foot (blurrier, softer colours).

pk-zl6e.title: Hidden coverage: market street with rug roof
pk-zl6e.summary: A busy market street is roofed with rugs. Like the rest of the coverage in this town, it is hidden.
